Fix Paragraph — textarea (whole-paragraph proofread in one pass)

The first line has multiple issues → a tiny Bean icon appears at the line's left. Click it → Fix Paragraph proofreads the WHOLE paragraph in one go (spelling + punctuation + capitalization + spacing), e.g. okay here's the next attemp . let's see if it shows its magic. → Okay, here's the next attempt. Let's see if it shows its magic.. No repeated passes. The single-issue last line gets no icon. (Needs the native bridge + Web Inline + API key for the full proofread; otherwise local fallback fixes obvious typos only.)

Fix Paragraph — line breaks preserved (fix first paragraph only)

Paragraph control — contenteditable blocks (icon per multi-issue block)

Each block with ≥2 issues gets its own paragraph icon; blocks group by DOM boundary (div/p), never across blocks.
